import { Box, TextField, Typography, Button, FormGroup, FormControlLabel, Checkbox } from "@mui/material";
import login_signup_back from "../assets/images/login-signup-back.png";

export default function Login() {
    return (
        <Box
            display="flex"
            justifyContent="center"
            alignItems="center"
            minHeight="100vh"  // 画面全体の高さに設定
            width="100%"
            padding={0}
            margin={0}
            overflow="hidden"
            style={{
                position: "relative",
                backgroundImage: `url(${login_signup_back})`,
                backgroundSize: "cover",
                backgroundPosition: "center",
                overflow: "hidden",  // 要素の外側のオーバーフローを隠す
            }}
        >
            <Box
                bgcolor="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)"
                borderRadius="8px"
                padding="40px"
                boxShadow="0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)"
                textAlign="center"
                width="90%"
                maxWidth="400px"
                style={{
                    backdropFilter: "blur(10px)",
                    WebkitBackdropFilter: "blur(10px)",
                }}
            >
                <Typography fontWeight="bold" fontSize="25px" mb="30px">
                    VSpaceへログイン
                </Typography>
                <TextField
                    id="email"
                    label="Email"
                    variant="outlined"
                    fullWidth
                    style={{ marginBottom: "15px" }}
                />
                <TextField
                    id="password"
                    label="Password"
                    variant="outlined"
                    fullWidth
                    style={{ marginBottom: "15px" }}
                    type="password"
                />
                <FormGroup style={{ marginBottom: "15px" }}>
                    <FormControlLabel
                        control={<Checkbox />}
                        label="自動ログイン"
                    />
                </FormGroup>
                <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    fullWidth
                    style={{ padding: "15px", backgroundColor: "black", color: "white" }}
                >
                    ログイン
                </Button>
            </Box>
        </Box>
    );
}
